turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to stop buying coffee every morning and make it at home instead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good plan, you'll save a lot. Do you want something simple like a French press, or are you ready to invest in an espresso machine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ben, do you want to do the raid tonight?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: What time? I've got work early tomorrow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Like eight? It should only take a couple of hours.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Last time you said that we finished at one in the morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That was because the tank kept disconnecting. We've got a new one now.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine. Eight, and I'm out by ten whatever happens.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Deal. I'll send everyone a message.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, all done here, back to the game.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi again. Decided between the French press and the espresso machine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: French press. I just want something that works at six in the morning.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great choice. Use coarse ground coffee and let it steep for about four minutes.
